Because no formal_spec file is submitted, the formal.run and formal.cover requirements do not apply to this task. The [req:AXIL-FORMAL] proof stays open and needs a follow-up task that supplies a single .sby file.

Both files carry `timescale 1ns/1ps`, which avoids Verilator's TIMESCALEMOD error.

The testbench requires READY to be high whenever it presents VALID with no response pending. This is how this design behaves (READY depends only on state), and it is how the back-to-back requirement [req:AXIL-B2B] gets checked.

The verdict line is printed exactly once. Either the main sequence prints it, or the watchdog prints it with the timeout counted as a failure. Whichever prints calls $finish.
